name: Consequence-Adaptive Decision-Sufficient Belief Compression
mechanism: Allocate a fixed representation/resolution budget by consequence, then change DSBC region-specific regret tolerance/compression granularity. The coupling alters which belief regions receive fine/coarse representation rather than merely reporting consequence.
removal_control: Same DSBC and same total representation budget with fixed/balanced allocation rather than consequence-adaptive allocation.
working_region: Frozen shell selected fine→critical and coarse→monitor while control selected balanced/balanced; consequence-weighted decision regret improved by about 0.20 and representation state count fell 4→3.
failure_or_collapse: Wrong consequence ranking produced about -0.31 gain; no universal superiority claim.
external_prior_art: Adaptive/resource-weighted compression literature; no new-theory claim.

name: Decision-Loss-Selected Adaptive Information Channel Controller
mechanism: DLEW selects the predictive model by downstream decision regret; the selected model determines AICC deployment belief mean and calibration-residual covariance before channel valuation. This can change channel value and measure/skip decisions.
removal_control: Same models/data/AICC/channels/costs but select predictive model by ordinary prediction RMSE.
working_region: Selected cost×channel-noise grid reported 9/9 cells with positive mean gain where RMSE selection bought unnecessary measurement.
failure_or_collapse: With free or near-perfect measurement the outcome advantage collapses to zero.
external_prior_art: Decision-aware model selection and value-of-information are established areas; composition claim only.

name: Support-Aware Covariance-Robust Decision-Sufficient Belief Compression
mechanism: Caller-supplied, coordinate-aligned belief-estimation error vectors are passed through SACPS; support-aware covariance defines a robust uncertainty stress set used inside DSBC merge admissibility. Same nominal tolerance can therefore yield different merge topology.
removal_control: Vanilla nominal DSBC at the same tolerance without covariance stress.
working_region: 40-cell sensitivity: 12 topology-change, 22 exact/operational collapse, 5 fail-closed, 1 mixed fail-closed.
failure_or_collapse: If uncertainty is so large that even a singleton belief is not robustly certifiable, fail closed rather than emit an unsafe compressed state. Zero stress collapses to DSBC. Missing coordinate alignment fails closed.
external_prior_art: Robust clustering/compression under uncertainty exists; no new-theory claim.

name: RECS-Weighted Observability Coverage
mechanism: With explicit record↔hidden-state coordinate alignment, RECS posterior×consequence risk reweights sensor/state geometry before the existing observability coverage planner selects sensors. This changes the sensor set rather than attaching a risk report after selection.
removal_control: Same sensor matrix/planner/budget on raw unweighted observability geometry.
working_region: 175-cell declared-risk sweep: 50 selection changes and 125 collapses; all 50 changed selections improved the declared risk-weighted observability proxy.
failure_or_collapse: Separate 36-cell miscalibration sweep against actual task gain: 12 positive, 15 negative, 9 zero. Miscalibrated declared risk can hurt; missing/unknown record↔state alignment fails closed.
external_prior_art: State-importance/observability-weighted sensor placement has strong prior art; internal composition operator only.

name: Support-Aware Covariance Adaptive Target-Relevance Memory
mechanism: At each ATRC eviction, first preserve parent authority by forming only the target-loss-safe deletion set. For those safe candidates, derive each memory item’s target-effect fingerprint using ATRC’s native predictor; SACPS then estimates dependency/redundancy geometry and evicts the most redundant item only within the safe set.
removal_control: Plain ATRC target-loss eviction. Zero tolerance or diagonal-only support collapses exactly to ATRC.
working_region: Frozen correct-support shell RMSE improved about 1.22155→0.12168. In 100-cell sensitivity, correct support with nonzero tolerance was 20/20 positive.
failure_or_collapse: Diagonal support 25/25 exact collapse. Wrong cross-regime support at tolerance 0.02 was 5/5 negative; frozen wrong-support RMSE worsened about 1.22155→1.40987.
external_prior_art: Diversity-aware memory/core-set methods exist; no new-theory claim.
